dimensions.description: Includes a recommendation, basis, material uncertainty, and evidence that could change it.
Presents the answer before detail and supports scanning without dropping requested content.
Preserves facts, evidence, uncertainty, requested breadth, and non-prose work products.
Removes filler and artificial patterns without standardizing contextual voice.

evals.name: complete human-facing deployment decision
evals.prompt: Recommend a deployment approach to the release owner. A staged rollout has verified rollback and a limited first cohort. Peak traffic remains untested, and the noon load test will report latency. Include the basis, the untested condition that matters, and what result would change the recommendation.
evals.expected_output: The treatment provides a complete human-facing decision with its canonical dependency, while the matched No-Skill control receives the same scenario without writing Skills.
expectations: The recommendation appears before supporting detail.
The output says what could change the recommendation.
The treatment retains all requested elements and contains no em dash.

basis: \b(?:verified rollback|rollback (?:is|was) verified|limited first cohort|small first cohort)\b
